title: Técnico(a) Segurança do Trabalho Jr.
description:
ATIVIDADES:

  • Aplicar a NR-9 PPRA (Programa de Prevenção de Riscos Ambientais) na empresa, obedecendo normas técnicas e legislação vigente.
  • Fazer análise de risco, dirigindo-se aos locais de trabalho operacional, fazendo medições de ruído, temperatura etc., bem como fiscalizar e orientar colaboradores na correta utilização dos EPI's e cumprimento dos procedimentos de segurança.
  • Fazer analise de risco em caso de mudança de função dos funcionários e/ou em caso de criação de novos cargos, afim de dar clareza sobre os riscos daquela determinada função e inseri-los no RM.
  • Preencher a CAT (comunicação de acidente de trabalho) com informações do departamento pessoal, de acordo com os padrões vigentes para envio ao MPAS (Ministério da Presidência e Assistência Social).
  • Enviar ao eSocial os eventos (S2210 e S2240) relacionados à segurança do trabalho periodicamente ou em caso de acidente de trabalho com afastamento.
  • Analisar acidentes ocorridos, elaborar relatório interno e no RM, adotando medidas de segurança a fim de prevenir novos acidentes.
  • Efetuar Treinamentos diversos tais como: Prevenção e Combate a Incêndio, CIPA, Integração, a fim de manter os colaboradores aptos e atualizados nos procedimentos, mantendo os padrões de qualidade e segurança do trabalho estabelecido pela legislação vigente.
  • Realizar mensalmente a reunião da CIPA (Comissão Interna de Prevenção de Acidentes) auxiliando na elaborando da Ata, enviando ao superior para controle e atendimento da legislação vigente.
  • Controlar, inserir e acompanhar a gestão da CIPA no RM.
  • Controlar e acompanhar o vencimento de extintores da empresa, analisando estado físico dos equipamentos, solicitando troca ou reparos quando necessário.
  • Manter documentação relacionados a segurança de todos os colaboradores da unidade, em arquivo próprio para consulta e fiscalização.
  • Dar assistência ao colaborador em caso de acidente de trabalho, levando ao hospital, se necessário e acompanhando no que for necessário.
  • Promover a melhoria contínua dos processos sob sua gestão, através da identificação, consolidação, monitoramento e análise dos indicadores, bem como a elaboração de planos de ação.

REQUISITOS:

  • Área de estudo: Técnico Segurança do Trabalho
  • Grau de instrução mínimo: Ensino Médio Técnico Completo
  • Grau de instrução desejável: Ensino Superior Cursando

title: Vendedor(a) / Consultor(a) Comercial
description:
Vendedor(a) / Consultor(a) Comercial - MedAcademy

Sobre o MedAcademy

No MedAcademy , somos apaixonados por transformar o futuro da medicina. Nossa missão é preparar médicos formados ou em formação para o desafio mais importante de suas carreiras: a prova de residência médica. Oferecemos cursos, plataformas de estudo e mentorias que combinam tecnologia, conteúdo de excelência e acompanhamento personalizado. Valorizamos a excelência, o foco no cliente (o futuro residente) e um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo. Junte-se a nós para impulsionar a aprovação dos próximos especialistas do país!

O(a) profissional será responsável por impulsionar o crescimento das vendas dos Cursos e Soluções MedAcademy para nosso público-alvo (estudantes de medicina e médicos recém-formados) em todo o Brasil.

•⁠ ⁠Gestão de Pipeline: Gerenciar todo o ciclo de vendas, desde a primeira abordagem e diagnóstico do cliente até a matrícula final no curso.

•⁠ ⁠Apresentação e Venda de Valor: Realizar apresentações persuasivas sobre o método MEDACADEMY, destacando o valor e o diferencial de nossos cursos na aprovação em residências de alto nível.

•⁠ ⁠Relacionamento: Desenvolver um relacionamento de confiança e credibilidade com os potenciais alunos.

•⁠ ⁠Metas: Alcançar e superar as metas de vendas, faturamento total (matrículas) mensais e anuais.

•⁠ ⁠CRM: Registrar e atualizar todas as interações e informações de clientes de forma precisa no sistema CRM.

•⁠ ⁠Feedback: Colaborar com as equipes de Produto e Conteúdo, fornecendo insights sobre as dúvidas e necessidades dos futuros residentes.

O Que Buscamos (Requisitos Obrigatórios)

title: Sales Manager, Laparoscope System
description:
About the Company

Reach Surgical, a Genesis Medtech Company, is a leading minimally-invasive surgical device manufacturer and supplier, committed to serving high-quality products to healthcare practitioners and patients worldwide. We deliver advanced technology and cost effective minimally-invasive surgical products to medical institutions and provide patients with reliable and economical treatment solutions.

About the Role

We are looking for a high-performing Sales Manager to spearhead regional sales management, drive business growth, and accelerate the expansion of Laparoscopic products for Brazil.

Responsibilities

As the Sales Manager, you will be responsible for the sales management of Laparoscopic products within the assigned geographic area and markets to achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue targets. You will conduct market research including customers and competitors’ activities and formulate and execute market development strategies. In addition, you will develop and build long-lasting relationships with stakeholders including distributors and healthcare professionals and obtain feedback on our products to internal stakeholders.

1. Development and Execution of Sales Plans

  • Sales Strategy and Execution: Define clear and measurable overseas sales goals, develop corresponding action plans, and execute them effectively to meet company objectives.
  • Market Intelligence: Conduct detailed hospital and micro-market analysis; maintain up-to-date market intelligence to understand industry trends and competitive landscapes.
  • Competitive Strategy: Formulate and implement effective competitive strategies based on insights into market dynamics and competitor activities.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Support regional marketing activities, leverage internal and external resources efficiently, and enhance overall customer value.
  • Decision-Making: Maintain a deep understanding of regional market conditions; identify emerging opportunities and potential challenges to make informed and timely decisions.

2. KOL (Key Opinion Leader) Management

  • Database Development : Establish and maintain a comprehensive overseas KOL informatio n archive.
  • Customer Insight : Analyze the potential and specific needs of KOLs to develop targeted engagement plans.
  • Relationship Management : Strategically allocate resources to build, strengthen, and sustain long-term cooperative relationships with KOLs.

3. Distributor Management

  • Distributor Development : Identify, evaluate, and onboard distributors that meet company criteria and strategic alignment.
  • Performance Support & Training: Provide motivation, ongoing support, and training to ensure distributors adhere to company standards and deliver expected outcomes.
  • Channel Optimization : Demonstrate strong communication and distributor management skills; conduct regular performance reviews and offer actionable feedback to maintain an effective and healthy distribution network.

A atuação acontece de acordo com a disponibilidade de agenda do(a) profissional. O volume de atendimentos e o potencial de remuneração acompanham a capacidade de agenda assumida e a evolução da carteira.

O papel central do(a) consultor(a) é apoiar empresários por meio de uma metodologia validada, contribuindo para a construção de laboratórios mais organizados, rentáveis, estruturados e menos dependentes do dono.

SOBRE A ACTIONCOACH

A ActionCOACH é a maior empresa de business coaching do mundo, presente em mais de 80 países e com mais de 30 anos de atuação global.

O escritório de Santa Catarina atua há mais de 18 anos no Brasil, com histórico consistente no desenvolvimento de empresários e empresas de pequeno e médio porte.

title: Líder Fertirrigação
description:
Que desafio temos para você?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Líder Fertirrigação para atuar no nosso time Tratos Culturais .

Quais as responsabilidades?

- Liderar as atividades de aplicação de vinhaça e água residual com o auxílio de subordinados diretos e indiretos, buscando maximizar a capacidade dos equipamentos de utilização, garantir a uniformidade da aplicação, respeitar as normas ambientais de aplicação, cuidar para que haja um perfeito sincronismo entre a produção e o emprego da vinhaça e água residual;

- Liderar a conservação dos canais de distribuição de vinhaça em perfeitas condições de uso;

- Distribuir a quantidade de vinhaça a ser aplicada de acordo com a Recomendação Agronômica.

- Especificar o local de irrigação, transporte e aplicação, orientando a equipe, visando seguir o planejamento de irrigação do início de safra.

- Administrar equipe de trabalho, capacitando, avaliando e adequando o quadro de pessoal.

Quais os requisitos?

- Formação em técnico agrícola, engenharia agronômica ou áreas afins;

- Experiência em Tratos Culturais e liderança de pessoas.

Qual localidade?

Guaíra/SP

O que buscamos num profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 12.000 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana-de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 15 países, 43 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.800 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2022/23, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de € 6,6 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas sete unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: AI Agent Manager (Media)
description:
About the Product

For more than 30 years, Carnegie has been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.

Job Purpose

The AI Agent Manager serves as the key technical and strategic resource for the company’s AI applications, with a focus on designing, building, operating, and managing complex AI agents. This role translates high-level business requirements into functional AI agent architectures, manages the full agent lifecycle (including advanced prompting, tooling, maintenance, and performance optimization), and ensures robust, measurable business outcomes.

The Manager owns the agent-building roadmap, advanced prompt engineering, agent configuration and deployment, performance monitoring, and cross-functional coordination to drive successful AI adoption across the organization.

Duties and Responsibilities

  • Main Responsibilities
  • Design, build, and maintain AI-powered workflows and agents using low-code/no-code and prompt-based platforms (e.g., multi-step prompt systems, agent frameworks).
  • Translate business requirements into scalable AI-driven solutions, especially for internal process automation (e.g., media planning, operations, finance workflows).
  • Configure and optimize multi-step AI prompts (“blueprints”) to automate complex tasks across different tools and systems.
  • Collaborate closely with product managers and business stakeholders to understand use cases and define solution logic.
  • Act as a bridge between business teams and technical infrastructure, ensuring solutions are usable by non-technical users.
  • Test, iterate, and improve AI agents to ensure reliability, accuracy, and performance in real-world use cases.
  • Identify opportunities for automation across departments and proactively propose AI-driven improvements.
  • Document workflows, prompt logic, and system configurations for internal reuse and scalability.
  • Stay up to date with advancements in AI tools, LLM capabilities, and no-code/low-code ecosystems.

Core Requirements

  • 4–7+ years of experience as a Business Analyst, System Analyst, or similar role.
  • Strong ability to translate business processes into structured workflows and logic.
  • Hands-on experience with low-code/no-code tools (e.g., Zapier, Make, Airtable, Retool, or similar platforms).
  • Experience working with AI tools (LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI automation platforms).
  • Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to work independently and own end-to-end solution delivery.
  • Advanced English proficiency (B2–C1 or higher)
  • Technical / AI-Related
  • Experience designing multi-step prompts or AI workflows (not just single prompts).
  • Understanding of how LLMs work and how to structure prompts for reliable outputs.
  • Familiarity with APIs, integrations, and automation tools is a plus.
  • Basic programming knowledge is helpful but not required.
  • Soft Skills
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work with non-technical stakeholders.
  • Business-oriented mindset with a focus on practical outcomes.
  • Curiosity and willingness to experiment with new AI tools and approaches.
  • Ability to operate in an ambiguous, fast-evolving environment.
  • Domain Experience
  • Experience in digital media, advertising tech, or media planning.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Proven ability to design, build, and operate sophisticated AI agents.
  • Expertise in advanced prompt engineering, including multi-step prompting, few-shot learning, and optimizing for specific model outputs.
  • Strong business analysis fundamentals: elicitation, documentation, process mapping, traceability, UAT.
  • Ability to produce and manage, work autonomously, and take initiative.
  • Exceptional relationship-building skills, cultural competency, and ability to communicate effectively with diverse groups of people and roles.
  • Dexterity to effectively deal with ambiguity, change, and continuous process improvements.

We offer

  • We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team.
  • Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule).
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Fully remote.

As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Digital Business Analyst
description:
Digital Business Analyst – Shape the Future of Energy Reporting & Operations!

We are recruiting on behalf of a global energy services organisation operating across Gas & Power Services. This programme sits at the heart of operational excellence, regulatory compliance, and customer transparency - replacing fragmented, manual reporting with a scalable digital reporting solution across complex industrial assets.

You’ll join a long-term, high-impact transformation programme focused on power plant operations, Operations & Maintenance (O&M), and performance reporting. This is a discovery-heavy role with real ownership, working directly with senior stakeholders to define what the product should be, before it’s built.

As a Digital Business Analyst, you’ll lead domain discovery, define product capabilities, and act as the bridge between business stakeholders and delivery teams to turn complex operational needs into a clear, scalable digital solution.

Your Role:

You’ll be the bridge between operations, data, and delivery. This is a senior, hands-on role where you’ll rapidly onboard into the Gas & Power Services domain, lead structured discovery, and shape a digital reporting product from the ground up - with ownership through to delivery and value realisation.

  • Define reporting requirements, data inputs, ownership models, and KPIs across performance, efficiency, safety, environmental, and financial metrics
  • Balance standardisation and configurability across plants, equipment types, and markets
  • Create and maintain product vision, roadmap, capability maps, and a prioritised backlog
  • Define the end-to-end data and reporting strategy - from data collection and validation through to dashboards and customer-facing outputs

  • Support planning, estimation, sequencing, and governance across a multi-phase programme
  • Track progress against milestones and help define what success looks like by September 2026

What You Bring:

  • Proven ability to lead discovery independently and bring structure to ambiguous environments
  • Experience working on data-driven products, reporting systems, or analytics platforms
  • Experience with international, enterprise environments
  • Excellent stakeholder management and facilitation skills across senior, operational, and technical audiences
  • Confidence translating complex operational domains into clear, actionable requirements
  • Exposure to energy, utilities, power generation, or industrial operations is highly desirable
  • Familiarity with operational KPIs, asset performance management, and HSE reporting is a strong plus

Why Join the Remobi community:

title: Senior Cloud Administrator
description:
As THE leader in transit technology, Clever Devices' vision is to make meaningful contributions to worldwide mobility. Our goal is to be the leading provider of exciting technology that improves the quality of mobility in communities around the world

This role will cover our open B (4PM - 12PM) shift.

Position Summary : The Senior Cloud Administrator is responsible for overseeing the design, implementation, and management of the organization's cloud infrastructure. This role involves ensuring the reliability, security, and scalability of cloud-based systems, as well as providing technical support and guidance to other team members.

Key Responsibilities :

  • Cloud Infrastructure Management : Manage and monitor day-to-day IT cloud infrastructure to ensure optimal performance and availability.

Qualifications :

  • Experience : At least 6 years of experience in cloud administration, including managing and optimizing cloud resources.

Please upload your CV Resume in English.

Monthly salary: $4,000 USD

The backend serves both a consumer-facing onboarding app and an internal admin operations dashboard.

Current Backend Stack:

  • GraphQL API server (single endpoint) likely built with NestJS + TypeGraphQL or similar Node.js/TypeScript framework
  • AWS Cognito for user authentication (SRP protocol, email + phone login, token refresh)
  • PostgreSQL database with relational schema (users, payments, vehicle loans, agreements, stage transitions)
  • Hosted on AWS (us-east-1 region)
  • Integrations: Plaid (bank linking), ACH payment processor, KYC/identity verification, PDF generation, e-sign

Backend Responsibilities:

  • 30+ GraphQL queries and 20+ mutations covering user lifecycle, payments, onboarding, and financial reporting
  • Multi-stage onboarding pipeline (11 stages):
  • signup → identity → bank link → cash flow → admin review → approval → micro-deposits → auto loan link → disclosure → payment setup → active
  • Payment scheduling, debt collection, refund processing
  • FBO (For Benefit Of) sub-ledger tracking
  • Credit line management and daily contribution calculations

Required Skills:

  • TypeScript / Node.js primary language
  • GraphQL schema design, resolvers, input validation (NestJS GraphQL module or Apollo Server)
  • PostgreSQL complex queries, migrations, enum types, indexing
  • AWS Cognito (SRP auth protocol), deployment (ECS / Lambda / AppSync)
  • Plaid API Link tokens, bank account verification, micro-deposits
  • ACH / Payment processing understanding of payment lifecycles, failed payment handling, refund flows (currently using Spinwheel.io)

Preferred Experience:

  • Fintech or payments industry background

title: Assistente de Comércio Exterior
description:
SOBRE NÓS

A ZAWA é uma empresa em crescimento contínuo no setor de importação e e-commerce, com atuação consolidada há mais de oito anos nos principais marketplaces do país. Com sede administrativa em Curitiba/PR e operação logística em Joinville/SC, trabalhamos com processos enxutos e uma estrutura organizacional compacta, composta por equipes de 5 a 10 pessoas. Mantemos o foco na qualidade, na eficiência operacional e na excelência no atendimento ao cliente.

Acreditamos que resultados sustentáveis nascem da autorresponsabilidade e da dedicação ao essencial. Nossa cultura, pautada na autonomia, colaboração, organização e praticidade, está refletida nos seguintes princípios:

  • Essencialismo: Priorizamos o que gera valor. Evitamos excesso de processos e mantemos ambientes físicos e digitais organizados e funcionais.
  • Responsabilidade individual: Esperamos que cada colaborador assuma o protagonismo da própria evolução, com consciência e compromisso.
  • Capricho e qualidade: A atenção aos detalhes é fundamental para nosso padrão de excelência. Prezamos entregas bem executadas, com precisão e zelo.
  • Melhoria contínua: Incentivamos a busca ativa por conhecimento. Entendemos que aprender e aprimorar são necessidades constantes.
  • Mentalidade orientada à solução: Além de identificar problemas e desafios, nossos profissionais buscam soluções viáveis, traduzindo ideias em planos de ação.

SOBRE A VAGA

Cargo: Assistente de Comércio Exterior

Tipo de contratação: PJ (híbrido)

Local: Sede administrativa – Rebouças, Curitiba/PR

Remuneração: R$ 3.000,00 - 4.000,00

Benefícios: 

  • PDI (Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual)
  • Bonificação trimestral por desempenho: +50% remuneração
  • Bonificação anual por meta da empresa batida: +13º remuneração

ATRIBUIÇÕES

O Assistente de Comércio Exterior será responsável pelo suporte operacional às rotinas de importação, garantindo a organização dos processos, a atualização das informações e o cumprimento dos prazos estabelecidos. Atuará no acompanhamento das etapas logísticas e documentais, interface com parceiros e apoio às demandas da área, contribuindo para a eficiência e controle das operações. Suas responsabilidades incluirão:

  • Apoiar na abertura, organização e acompanhamento de processos de importação;
  • Apoiar estudo de viabilidade para importação de novos produtos, incluindo classificação fiscal (NCM), análise de tributos, benefícios fiscais e exigências regulatórias (ANVISA, INMETRO, ANATEL, etc);
  • Realizar follow-up com fornecedores internacionais, tradings , agentes de carga, despachantes e áreas internas, garantindo alinhamento das informações;
  • Acompanhar as etapas de transporte internacional, garantindo o cumprimento de prazos produtivos, logísticos e documentais (ETD, ETA, embarque e entrega);
  • Conferir e organizar documentos de importação (Commercial Invoice, Packing List, Bill of Lading, entre outros);
  • Apoiar na conferência de notas fiscais de entrada e processos fiscais relacionados;
  • Auxiliar na cotação de fretes internacionais e serviços logísticos;
  • Solicitar pagamentos internacionais e operações de câmbio, conforme orientação da área;
  • Desenvolver relatórios operacionais e indicadores da área;
  • Atualizar sistemas internos, planilhas e controles com prazos, status e informações das operações;
  • Contribuir para a padronização e melhoria contínua dos processos internos;
  • Atuar na resolução de problemas operacionais e na mitigar riscos relacionados aos processos de importação.

REQUISITOS E QUALIFICAÇÃO

Competências obrigatórias:

-Ensino superior completo ou em andamento em Comércio Exterior, Relações Internacionais, Administração ou áreas correlatas;

- Comunicação escrita: capacidade de conduzir interações contínuas e assíncronas via chat de forma estruturada, objetiva e sequencial, considerando fuso horário e dinâmica cultural de fornecedores internacionais (especialmente asiáticos);

- Excel intermediário/avançado

- Inglês intermediário (leitura e escrita);

- Conhecimento em matemática básica aplicada.

  Competências desejadas:

  • Vivência em rotinas operacionais de comércio exterior e processos de importação;
  • Experiência em negociações internacionais;
  • Conhecimento em cálculo de custos de importação (produto, frete, impostos e despesas operacionais).

EXPECTATIVAS

O que buscamos:

  • Perfil analítico, lógico e metódico;
  • Postura voltada para resultados e performance;
  • Atenção aos detalhes e alto nível de precisão;
  • Habilidade para lidar com múltiplas demandas simultaneamente, mantendo organização e clareza.
  • Capacidade de síntese e priorização de informações;
  • Proatividade e autonomia;

O que oferecemos: 

  • Treinamento técnico e desenvolvimento pessoal;
  • Direcionamento estratégico;
  • Objetividade na cobrança e no feedback;
  • Ambiente de alta autonomia e responsabilidade;
  • Atuação em um time colaborativo;
  • Sinceridade e transparência.

ETAPAS DO PROCESSO SELETIVO

  • Teste avaliativo – Enviado por e-mail aos candidatos selecionados.

  • Feedback e contratação – Formalização da contratação.

Nossa equipe te espera!

title: Sales AI Agent Builder
description:
Sales AI Agent Builder

Role Overview:

You will architect and manage a fleet of autonomous Sales Agents that perform end-to-end prospecting, qualification, and meeting scheduling. Unlike traditional Sales Ops, you won't just build workflows; you will build reasoning systems that research prospects, handle objections, and manage their own "inboxes" to deliver qualified meetings to our SEs. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Key Responsibilities:

• Autonomous Lead Qualification: Design agents to "vet" inbound leads by querying external data sources and internal CRM history to determine if they meet our Ideal Customer Profile (ICP).

• Inbox Management & Objection Handling: Deploy agents (using LLMs like GPT-4o or Claude) that can read incoming emails, categorize intent, and draft/send context-aware replies to handle common objections.

• Live Sales Assistant (RAG): Build a "Sales Knowledge Base" using Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) so agents can instantly reference case studies, pricing, and competitor battlecards during autonomous chats.

• CRM Data Integrity: Ensure agents "write back" all interactions to Salesforce/HubSpot, keeping data clean and attribution accurate without rep intervention.

Qualifications:

• Experience: 4+ years in Growth or Solutions Engineering in a B2B SaaS environment.

• AI Tooling: Experience with "Agent-as-a-Service" platforms (e.g., 11x, Regie.ai, Lyzr) or building custom agents via LangChain / LangGraph.

• Sales Stack Mastery: Deep expertise in Salesforce/HubSpot, Salesloft/Outreach, and data providers like ZoomInfo or 6sense.

• Analytical Rigor: Ability to A/B test agent prompts and "reasoning loops" to improve meeting-set rates.

title: Técnico(a) de Manutenção Elétrica
description:
Sobre a vaga

No país desde 2002, a Arauco atua nos segmentos Florestal e de Madeiras com o propósito de, a partir da natureza e de fontes renováveis, contribuir com as pessoas e o planeta. Emprega mais de 3000 colaboradores próprios e conta com 5 unidades industriais brasileiras.

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS).

Com atuação orientada por práticas ESG, a Arauco possui certificação FSC® (Forest Stewardship Council®) em suas florestas, que reconhece o manejo ambientalmente responsável, socialmente justo e economicamente viável. A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.

Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.

Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência.

Principais atividades:

  • Instalar e efetuar manutenção de equipamentos elétricos;
  • Executar as rotinas de inspeção, de manutenções preventivas e corretivas;
  • Reparar sistemas elétricos;
  • Interpretar desenhos, esquemas e diagramas elétricos;
  • Realizar montagem de comandos elétricos para novas aplicações;
  • Auxiliar na instalação de equipamentos e máquinas;
  • Identificar defeitos nas máquinas e instalações.

Requisitos:

  • Técnico Completo em Elétrica, Eletrônica, Eletromecânica ou Eletrotécnica;
  • Experiência em manutenção elétrica de máquinas e equipamentos industriais;
  • NR 10 básico e NR 10 SEP;
  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar em turnos de revezamento;
  • Disponibilidade para residir em Jaguariaíva ou Arapoti.

title: Front End Technical lead-AI
description:
• Technical Lead, AI and Engineering
  • 100% Remote LATAM

    • This is a combination of Lead, Front end - React and Next JS hands on development, and Generative AI

    Candidates should have been at a Lead capacity overseeing multiple projects. They could be a people manager as well - but should be hands on with development

    Candidates have to clear React Hacker Rank coding test

    Our client is building a scalable, AI-enabled platform that helps founders turn ideas into real ventures. As a Tech Lead, you’ll play a key role in shaping the core architecture and AI infrastructure, with real ownership over how the platform is designed, built, and scaled.

    Job Description

    Job Summary:

    Lead development and implementation of complex information technology projects and architecture to solve problems with wide impact, requiring high levels of functional integration.

    The Technical Lead acts as the primary architectural authority and engineering manager for the platform. This hands-on role is responsible for architecting scalable technical solutions, managing the engineering team, and working closely with the Product Team and Business Leadership to build AI-powered tools that deliver measurable value.

    Job-Specific Responsibilities:

    Technical Architecture & Strategy

    • Architect, design, and provide hands-on contribution to the development and deployment of scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions that support business goals and product initiatives.
    • Make technical design choices and follow technical standards, including cyber security, software languages, tools, and infrastructure.
    • Balance fast, lean innovation with practical implementation, technical feasibility, technical debt, and system stability in production environments.
    • Evaluate emerging AI technologies and determine their applicability to platform needs and understand risk mitigation strategies.

    Engineering Leadership & Priorities

    • Manage the engineering team in alignment with product roadmap and critical deadlines.
    • Translate business and product requirements into detailed technical specs and engineering tasks.
    • Mentor software developers, conduct code reviews, and ensure high-quality coding.
    • Oversee the software product development lifecycle, including MLOps, CI/CD pipelines, testing frameworks, and release management, as well as data pipelines, and governance.

    Product Collaboration

    • Partner with the Product Team, Designers, and Business Director to align on strategic priorities, estimate development effort, and define timelines.
    • Communicate complex technical concepts and trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders including executives and customers.

    Ethics & Risk Management

    • Ensure responsible data management and AI practices (fairness, transparency, and data privacy) and ensure governance frameworks for AI model deployment and monitoring.
    • Navigate regulatory requirements, security needs, and compliance consideration.

    Other Responsibilities:

    • Build trust and collaboration by being present on-site and engaging directly with colleagues and various constituents.
    • This role is responsible for other duties as assigned.

    Qualifications

    Basic Qualifications:

    • Minimum of seven years’ post-secondary education or relevant work experience

    Additional Required Qualifications:

    • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field
    • 8+ years of Software Engineering (ideally AI-focused) experience, including 2+ years in a Lead Engineer, Architect, or equivalent technical leadership role

    Core Technical Expertise:

    Deep understanding of and strong hands-on experience with:

    • Application & Product Engineering
    • Modern web application architecture, including frontend, middleware, backend, and full-stack development
    • Languages and frameworks including Python, TypeScript/JavaScript, NextJS, React, Node.js, and SQL
    • APIs, Services & Data
    • Microservices and API design, including REST and GraphQL
    • Asynchronous and event-driven systems
    • Authentication and authorization
    • Data and storage systems (relational, NoSQL, and vector databases)
    • Cloud Platforms & Infrastructure
    • Cloud-native and distributed systems design
    • Containerization and orchestration (e.g., Terraform, Docker)
    • AWS , including Bedrock, SageMaker, EC2, Lambda, S3, RDS, and IAM
    • Additional cloud platforms (Azure, GCP) and cloud-agnostic design principles
    • DevOps, MLOps & Delivery
    • CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure as code
    • Model deployment, monitoring, and operational reliability
    • AI & LLM Systems
    • AI/ML tools and frameworks (e.g., LangGraph) and production-grade API integrations
    • Design, deployment, and evaluation of LLM-powered systems, including prompt engineering and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures

title: Eletromecânico
description:
Descrição da empresa:

Somos uma empresa que projeta, dimensiona e fabrica sistemas e equipamentos para tratamento de água e efluente para indústrias e companhias públicas. Atuamos desde a concepção do projeto até a instalação e operação dos sistemas, buscamos entregar para nossos clientes processos de tratamento eficientes e com baixo custo para que seus negócios se tornem mais viáveis e sustentáveis.

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um Eletromecânico para atuar na montagem, instalação e manutenção de equipamentos e sistemas de tratamento de água e efluentes, tanto em fábrica quanto em campo (canteiros de obras). O profissional será responsável por executar atividades elétricas e mecânicas, incluindo montagem de painéis, interligações elétricas, instalação de motores, bombas, válvulas e instrumentação.

Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Ler desenhos e orientações técnicas para execução das montagens e instalações;
  • Realizar a montagem eletromecânica de equipamentos e sistemas de tratamento de água e efluentes;
  • Executar montagem de painéis elétricos e interligações de cabos em campo;
  • Instalar e conectar motores elétricos, bombas, válvulas e instrumentos;
  • Realizar passagem, organização e fixação de cabos elétricos;
  • Executar testes básicos de funcionamento elétrico e mecânico dos equipamentos;
  • Apoiar na partida (start-up) e ajustes dos sistemas em campo;
  • Identificar e corrigir falhas simples em instalações elétricas e mecânicas;
  • Utilizar ferramentas manuais e elétricas para montagem e instalação;
  • Seguir os padrões de qualidade e segurança durante a execução das atividades;
  • Manter o local de trabalho organizado e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas.

Competências técnicas esperadas:

  • Curso técnico na área elétrica, eletromecânica ou automação (obrigatório);
  • Experiência em montagem eletromecânica e instalações elétricas industriais;
  • Conhecimento em ligação de motores, bombas e painéis elétricos;
  • Noções de leitura de diagramas elétricos e desenhos técnicos;
  • Conhecimento básico em instrumentação e testes elétricos;
  • Conhecimento em normas de segurança (NR-10 obrigatório; NR-35 e NR-33 como diferencial);

Competências comportamentais esperadas:

  • Comprometimento com prazos e qualidade na execução dos serviços;
  • Responsabilidade e disciplina no cumprimento de normas, principalmente de segurança elétrica;
  • Atenção e cuidado na execução de atividades técnicas;
  • Organização com cabos, ferramentas e local de trabalho;
  • Proatividade para identificar e resolver problemas simples em campo;
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Capacidade de seguir procedimentos e orientações técnicas;
  • Flexibilidade para atuar em diferentes atividades (elétrica e mecânica);
  • Disponibilidade e adaptação à rotina de obras e viagens.

Horário de trabalho:

Presencialmente de segunda à quinta-feira das 07:30 às 17:30 e de sexta-feira das 07:30 às 16:30.

Local de trabalho:

Residir na região de Salto, Indaiatuba e Itu.

A combinar

  • Auxílio educacional;

title: Account Manager - Soluções de Cibersegurança
description:
1) Sobre a SolutionMall

A SolutionMall é uma plataforma global B2B focada no fornecimento de soluções integradas e produtos profissionais para projetos de infraestrutura e indústria.

Não atuamos apenas como uma plataforma tradicional de fornecimento de produtos. Damos grande importância à segurança, praticidade e adequação de sistemas e equipamentos utilizados em projetos reais, sempre considerando as necessidades de operação de longo prazo.

Na visão da SolutionMall, a cibersegurança não se limita a uma única categoria de software. Ela é um requisito essencial em sistemas, dispositivos conectados e na lógica geral de implantação de projetos. Mesmo em equipamentos básicos, valorizamos protocolos de comunicação segura, gestão de senhas, controle de acesso e proteção de privacidade. Acreditamos que a segurança deve ser incorporada desde o início no desenho do sistema, na seleção de produtos e na lógica de implementação.

Para sustentar esse princípio, a SolutionMall também dá atenção especial à verificação de cibersegurança e aos padrões de segurança em nível de dispositivo antes que os produtos sejam incorporados às soluções de projeto.

2) Visão Geral da Função

Estamos procurando um Gerente de Desenvolvimento de Negócios – Soluções de Cibersegurança para apoiar a expansão da atuação da SolutionMall no Brasil .

Esta é uma função part-time, baseada em cooperação . Procuramos alguém que possa trabalhar de forma flexível com a SolutionMall para apoiar:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionados à cibersegurança
  • comunicação com clientes e educação de mercado
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • promoção de conceitos de soluções orientadas à segurança
  • coordenação entre as necessidades do cliente e a direção técnica da SolutionMall

Esta posição não é destinada a um pesquisador acadêmico de segurança pura, e também não é uma vaga tradicional de vendas em tempo integral. Procuramos alguém que compreenda o valor prático da cibersegurança em sistemas reais e consiga impulsionar tanto a conscientização dos clientes quanto as oportunidades de negócio.

A função combina principalmente:

  • desenvolvimento de negócios relacionados à cibersegurança
  • promoção de soluções e conceitos
  • comunicação com clientes e parceiros
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto
  • comunicação técnico-comercial básica sobre segurança
  • cooperação no desenvolvimento de mercado de longo prazo

3) Principais Responsabilidades

Desenvolvimento de Negócios e Expansão de Mercado

  • Desenvolver oportunidades comerciais relacionadas a soluções de cibersegurança, sistemas com foco em segurança e requisitos de projeto orientados à segurança
  • Promover a abordagem da SolutionMall voltada à segurança em projetos de infraestrutura, indústria e sistemas conectados
  • Identificar clientes em potencial, parceiros, consultores, integradores e demais stakeholders de projetos que valorizem cibersegurança e proteção de privacidade
  • Ajudar a ampliar a percepção do mercado de que a cibersegurança deve ser um requisito padrão na seleção e implantação de sistemas

Comunicação com Clientes e Promoção do Conceito de Segurança

  • Comunicar aos clientes a importância prática da cibersegurança em sistemas e equipamentos conectados
  • Ajudar a explicar por que requisitos relacionados à segurança são importantes, incluindo:
  • suporte a
  • evitar senhas simples, padrão ou fracas
  • configuração de senhas definidas pelo usuário
  • controle de permissões
  • proteção de privacidade
  • Apoiar a SolutionMall na promoção de uma mentalidade mais forte de segurança em projetos nos quais a cibersegurança ainda não seja totalmente priorizada

Acompanhamento de Oportunidades de Projeto

  • Acompanhar necessidades de clientes e oportunidades de projeto relacionadas a aplicações sensíveis à segurança
  • Ajudar a identificar em quais cenários a cibersegurança pode se tornar um fator importante na tomada de decisão do projeto
  • Apoiar discussões de projeto em que sejam relevantes seleção segura de produtos, controle de acesso ao sistema e requisitos ligados à privacidade
  • Auxiliar na conversão do interesse do cliente em discussões comerciais práticas e oportunidades concretas de projeto

Coordenação Técnica e de Soluções

  • Manter uma compreensão prática das expectativas básicas de cibersegurança para sistemas e equipamentos conectados
  • Apoiar a comunicação entre clientes e equipes da SolutionMall em relação ao posicionamento de produtos com foco em segurança
  • Ajudar a alinhar as necessidades dos clientes com a direção de soluções orientadas à segurança da SolutionMall
  • Auxiliar na apresentação da cibersegurança não apenas como um tema de conformidade, mas também como um requisito de confiança e operação de longo prazo

Relacionamento com Parceiros e Feedback de Mercado

  • Construir relacionamentos com clientes locais, parceiros de canal, consultores e stakeholders técnicos
  • Compartilhar feedback de mercado sobre conscientização dos clientes, preocupações com segurança, tendências de projeto e expectativas relacionadas à privacidade

  • vendas de soluções de segurança

  • Experiência com clientes que exigem maior atenção à segurança, privacidade ou conformidade
  • Familiaridade com dispositivos conectados, plataformas de monitoramento, sistemas inteligentes ou equipamentos em rede
  • Capacidade de apoiar tanto o desenvolvimento de negócios quanto o acompanhamento prático de projetos
  • Português é altamente desejável, e outros idiomas locais ou regionais podem ser uma vantagem adicional

5) Cobertura

Esta função apoia o desenvolvimento de negócios da SolutionMall em cibersegurança no Brasil .

Dependendo das oportunidades de projeto e das prioridades de mercado, o profissional selecionado poderá apoiar:

  • comunicação comercial relacionada a projetos

em mercados nos quais a conscientização sobre cibersegurança esteja se tornando cada vez mais importante para sistemas conectados e soluções de infraestrutura.

6) Modelo de Trabalho

Esta é uma função part-time sob um modelo baseado em cooperação .

Buscamos alguém que possa trabalhar com a SolutionMall de forma contínua e contribuir por meio de:

  • desenvolvimento de mercado em cibersegurança
  • acompanhamento de clientes e parceiros
  • desenvolvimento de oportunidades relacionadas à segurança
  • comunicação técnico-comercial
  • suporte à coordenação de projetos

Esta função foi desenhada para uma cooperação prática e flexível, e não para uma estrutura tradicional de trabalho integral em escritório.

7) Remuneração

A remuneração é baseada em desempenho e vinculada à contribuição real, incluindo:

  • resultados de desenvolvimento de negócios
  • acompanhamento de oportunidades de projeto

A estrutura detalhada será compartilhada com os candidatos selecionados.

title: Senior Customer Success Manager — Google Ads & LinkedIn Ads
description:
Company: ScalixAI Location: Fully Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: Founder / CEO About ScalixAI

ScalixAI is a performance-focused Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads agency built on one principle: paid media should drive real business outcomes, not vanity metrics. Founded by a former 8-year Google veteran, we work with ambitious SaaS companies, B2B brands, nonprofits, home services operators, and growth-stage businesses who expect more than dashboards — they expect partnership, strategy, and results.

We're small, sharp, and scaling. This role is central to how we grow.

The Role

We're hiring a Senior Customer Success Manager who lives at the intersection of Google Ads expertise, LinkedIn Ads fluency, and high-trust client relationships. You'll own a book of business end-to-end — from kickoff through renewal — and be the strategic voice clients rely on when they want to know why the numbers are moving and what to do next .

This isn't a reporting role. This is a thinking-partner role. You'll build campaigns that actually ladder up to revenue, translate performance into narrative, and hold the line on strategy when clients push in unproductive directions.

What You'll Own
  • Client relationships. You are the face of ScalixAI for your accounts. You lead weekly/bi-weekly calls, quarterly business reviews, and the hard conversations that come with managing paid media budgets.
  • Campaign strategy and execution. You build, optimize, and scale Google Ads (Search, PMax, Demand Gen, Display, YouTube) and LinkedIn Ads (Sponsored Content, Message Ads, Lead Gen Forms, ABM campaigns) across multiple verticals.
  • Storytelling through data. You turn performance data into a narrative the client's CEO, CMO, or founder actually wants to read. Numbers alone don't retain clients — meaning does.
  • Attribution and measurement. You set up clean measurement (GA4, LinkedIn Insight Tag, conversion APIs, offline conversion imports) and defend the integrity of attribution when the data gets messy.
  • Proactive optimization. You don't wait for the client to ask. You spot, flag, and fix.
  • Retention and expansion. You identify opportunities to expand scope and you catch churn signals before they become churn.
What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 5–8 years of hands-on paid media experience, with meaningful time spent in both Google Ads and LinkedIn Ads (not just one with a side of the other)
  • Direct, in-platform experience with Fibbler
  • Proven track record managing client relationships as the primary point of contact — ideally in an agency or consultancy setting
  • Strong storytelling ability: you can write a QBR narrative, present on Zoom with confidence, and explain a CPA spike in a way that builds trust rather than erodes it
  • Deep technical fluency in campaign architecture, bidding strategies, audience segmentation, creative testing, and conversion tracking across both platforms
  • Comfort with attribution conversations — last-click vs. data-driven, view-through, offline conversion imports, CRM-integrated measurement
  • B2B and SaaS paid media experience

Bonus:

  • HVAC, home services, or nonprofit vertical experience
  • Familiarity with tools like HubSpot, Salesforce, GA4, Looker Studio, Supermetrics, HockeyStack, or similar
  • LinkedIn Marketing Labs certification and/or Google Ads certifications
  • Experience building SOPs, onboarding docs, or client-facing collateral
Who Thrives Here
  • You treat client accounts like you own them, because at ScalixAI, you effectively do.
  • You have opinions and you can defend them — but you also know when to flex.
  • You're allergic to fluff. You'd rather say "here's what's working, here's what isn't, here's what we're changing" than hide behind a 40-slide deck.
  • You want to work on a team that moves fast, ships work, and treats paid media as a craft — not a commodity.
What We Offer
  • Fully remote — work from anywhere that overlaps reasonably with North American client hours
  • Direct access to the founder and real input on how the agency is built
  • A portfolio of clients who actually want to be partnered with (we screen hard at the front door)
  • Room to grow into team leadership as we scale
How to Apply

Send us:

  1. A short note on the most interesting paid media problem you've solved in the last 12 months — across either Google or LinkedIn
  2. Your resume or LinkedIn profile
  3. One QBR, case study, or client-facing deliverable you're proud of (redact as needed)
  • We read everything. We respond to everyone who takes the time to apply thoughtfully.

title: Full Stack Ruby Engineer
description:
Full Stack Ruby Engineer

Our Client's Company: Our client's company is a healthcare technology company that provides convenient, in-home physical therapy by connecting patients with licensed therapists and delivering personalized care through a tech-enabled platform.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a seasoned Senior Full Stack Engineer with deep Ruby expertise to lead development on our core API and front-end systems. You will own high-impact features across our healthcare technology platform, with a focus on third-party integrations, robust backend logic, and intuitive frontend user experiences. This is a high-visibility engineering role with end-to-end ownership and the opportunity to shape the product roadmap.

Responsibilities:

Backend (Ruby, Sinatra)

  • Architect, build, and maintain scalable APIs and automation services using Ruby (Sinatra framework).
  • Lead development of complex integrations with third-party services such as Zoho CRM/Desk, Clinicient EMR, Stripe, DropboxSign, and AWS S3.
  • Manage data workflows and background processing using Rake tasks and ActiveRecord.
  • Optimize system performance and resolve bottlenecks in data-heavy environments.
  • Uphold best practices in code structure, security (HIPAA compliance), testing (RSpec), and maintainability.
  • Contribute to architectural decisions including data modeling and service boundaries.
  • Operate within a GitLab CI/CD and Docker containerization environment.

Frontend (React, JS)

  • Build and maintain dynamic user-facing components using React.js and modern JavaScript (ES6+).
  • Ensure responsive, cross-browser-compatible UI with clean HTML5/CSS3 implementation.
  • Integrate front-end features with RESTful backend services.
  • Debug and resolve frontend performance and usability issues.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of full-stack development experience with a strong backend focus.
  • Expert-level Ruby developer; hands-on experience with Sinatra or Rails.
  • Solid understanding of object-oriented design and architecture patterns (e.g., Service Objects).
  • Strong PostgreSQL skills: schema design, complex queries, and performance tuning.
  • Deep experience with RESTful APIs and background job frameworks.
  • Proven RSpec test coverage practices; TDD mindset.
  • Proficient in React.js and ES6+ JavaScript.
  • Working knowledge of Git, CI/CD workflows, Docker.
  • Detail-oriented, security-minded, and comfortable working in healthcare-compliant environments.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience in healthcare tech or HIPAA-compliant environments.
  • Familiarity with Clinicient, Zoho CRM/Desk, Stripe, DropboxSign, AWS S3.
  • Understanding of caching strategies and optimizing high-throughput systems.
  • Experience with TypeScript, performance profiling, or analytics instrumentation.
  • Leverage AI tools to support frontend development.

What We Offer

  • Fully remote, flexible working environment.
  • Mission-driven culture focused on improving healthcare delivery.
  • Opportunity to lead and grow within a fast-moving, high-impact startup.
  • Collaborative, engineering-led product development process.

title: Indirect Tax Manager
description:
About Us:

Temu tax team ensures compliance with local and international tax laws while optimizing the company’s tax position. We are seeking a proactive and experienced Tax BP to support our tax compliance and audit activities in Brazil. This role will be critical in ensuring full compliance with Brazilian tax regulations, managing tax audits, and acting as a key liaison between internal teams and external tax authorities. The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of Brazilian tax legislation, excellent communication skills in both Portuguese and English, and the ability to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.

Job description

  1. The Tax Senior/Manager will be responsible for the management of indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning, ensuring compliance with current legislation and the optimization of the tax burden;

  3. Monitor tax compliance processes and work closely with internal accounting and finance teams to ensure tax obligations are met.
  4. Manage and respond to federal, state, and municipal tax audits, including coordinating documentation and liaising with auditors and tax authorities.
  5. Analyze changes in Brazilian tax legislation and assess potential business impacts, providing recommendations for compliance.

Desired profile

  1. Education: Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or Law. Advanced degree or CPA certification preferred.
  2. Solid experience in indirect taxes, tax compliance and tax planning;
  3. Knowledge in Tax reform;
  4. Excellent interpersonal skills and communication skills with different stakeholders;

Language:

  • Fluent in Portuguese (native proficiency).
  • Fluent in English (written & spoken) – must liaise with global teams.

At Temu, we are proud to be an employer that builds a diverse community. We encourage all qualified individuals to apply and join our team. We are dedicated to providing a work environment free from discrimination and harassment, where all employees are treated with respect and dignity.

Apply today to join Temu and be part of a dynamic and innovative company.

title: Almoxarife Sênior
description:
Principais atividades:

• Receber as mercadorias diariamente de acordo com a janela de recebimento;

• Conferir as informações sobre os itens, as marcas, as quantidades, o fornecedor e a data de entrega conforme o pedido;

• Receber o fornecedor, o estoquista deve conferir os dados na nota fiscal para que se certificar que a entrega é referente ao pedido de compras.

• Receber e conferir dos materiais, o comprovante de recebimento deve ser assinado e devolvido ao entregador;

• Caso ocorra alguma divergência (quantidade, item faltante, embalagem violada etc.), informe ao comprador e após definição da solução, notifique no verso do comprovante;

• Após conferir o recebimento, os itens perecíveis devem ser acondicionados primeiro e os itens secos na sequência;

• Realizar o armazenamento de forma que os itens com vencimento próximo sejam disponibilizados nas prateleiras e freezers para consumo seja priorizado. (conceito FIFO – primeiro que entra / primeiro que sai).

• Atualizar o estoque no sistema com as quantidades e envie a nota ao comprador;

• Realizar as distribuições de insumos / bebidas conforme as solicitações de cada evento / espaço seguindo a requisição;

• Após fazer a distribuição solicitar o de acordo do responsável da cozinha / coordenador de eventos.

Formação / conhecimentos:

• Ter pelo menos ensino médio completo (desejável graduação)

• Cursos na área de almoxarifado, logística, armazenamento de alimentos, ...

Experiência

• Ter pelo menos 3 anos de experiência em logística / distribuição e almoxarifado.

• Conhecimento de Office (Excel, Power Point e Word);

Habilidades

• Boa comunicação verbal e escrita;

• Atitude e iniciativa;

• Habilidade trabalhar em equipe.

• Organização.

Requisitos adicionais

• Ter flexibilidade de horário.

title: HRBP Senior Manager
description:

Keeta is the international subsidiary of Meituan, a global giant in the delivery sector, and we’re on a bold mission: to revolutionize food and consumer goods delivery around the world. Our motto is simple yet powerful: “We help people eat better, live better.”

title: Java Applications Support
description:
ROLE: Java Applications Support (L2/L3)

LOCATION : SAO PAULO, BRAZIL.

WORKING MODEL : ONSITE (5 DAYS IN A WEEK)

LANGUAGE REQUIRED: ENGLISH (FLUENT)

Job Summary:

We’re looking for a hands-on L3 Support Engineer who will act as the escalation point for critical production issues across

trading and risk systems. The role focuses on deep incident diagnosis, partnering with engineering for fixes and reliability

improvements, and building the tooling, runbooks, and documentation that enable L1/L2 teams to resolve issues faster.

Responsibilities:

 Own L3 escalations end-to-end: triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident follow-up with engineering

and stakeholders.

 Partner with product and engineering to improve reliability, operability, and supportability of applications, including

logging, metrics, and alert quality.

 Develop scripts, runbooks, diagnostics, and quality-of-life tools that streamline investigations and reduce meantime to

resolution.

 Create and maintain clear documentation for L1/L2 teams; deliver enablement sessions as needed.

 Contribute to incident reviews and problem management, driving permanent fixes and automation for recurring issues.

 Participate in a limited weekend/on-call rotation (approximately 4–6 weekends per year) with compensating time-off

per policy.

Minimum qualifications:

 Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent experience) and 3+ years in software engineering or production support.

 Proficient in Java or a similar language; strong debugging skills and ability to write scripts for diagnostics and updates.

Familiarity with Linux and bash.

 Clear, empathetic communicator capable of translating complex technical issues for diverse audiences.

 Demonstrated bias for action: resolve incidents while building long-term fixes and automations.

 Strong problem-solving: identify edge cases, add validations, and anticipate failure modes.

 Experience with SDLC and support tooling: GitLab, incident management, JIRA, and standard ticket triage/prioritization.

Preferred qualifications:

 Experience supporting trading systems or desks at a large investment bank.

 SQL proficiency for rapid data validation and incident triage.

 Experience with object-oriented programming and microservices-based Java/SOA environments.

title: Soldador
description:
Descrição da empresa:

Somos uma empresa que projeta, dimensiona e fabrica sistemas e equipamentos para tratamento de água e efluente para indústrias e companhias públicas. Atuamos desde a concepção do projeto até a instalação e operação dos sistemas, buscamos entregar para nossos clientes processos de tratamento eficientes e com baixo custo para que seus negócios se tornem mais viáveis e sustentáveis.

Descrição da vaga:

Buscamos um Soldador qualificado, com experiência em soldagem de tubulações e estruturas metálicas, para atuação em fábrica e em campo (canteiros de obras). O profissional será responsável por executar cortes, montagens e soldas, garantindo o alinhamento, vedação e integridade dos sistemas. Espera-se domínio no uso de equipamentos de soldagem, leitura básica de desenho e compromisso com segurança, produtividade e qualidade na execução dos serviços.

Responsabilidades do dia a dia:

  • Ler desenhos e orientações técnicas para entender o serviço a ser executado;
  • Definir o tipo de solda e equipamento mais adequado para cada aplicação (MIG, TIG, eletrodo revestido);
  • Preparar as peças antes da soldagem, realizando limpeza, corte, chanfro e ajuste de tubulações e estruturas;
  • Utilizar esmerilhadeira e outras ferramentas para acabamento e preparação das superfícies;
  • Posicionar e alinhar corretamente tubulações e estruturas metálicas, garantindo encaixe e nível;
  • Executar soldas em tubulações de aço carbono e inox, garantindo vedação e qualidade das juntas;
  • Realizar soldas em estruturas metálicas, como suportes, bases, chapas, perfis e vigas;
  • Executar soldas em diferentes posições (plana, horizontal e vertical), conforme necessidade da obra;
  • Realizar reparos e reforços em peças e equipamentos quando necessário;
  • Inspecionar visualmente as soldas, identificando e corrigindo falhas;
  • Zelar pelos equipamentos de solda e manter o local de trabalho organizado e seguro.

Competências técnicas esperadas:

  • Experiência comprovada como soldador;
  • Experiência no uso de diferentes equipamentos e procedimentos de soldagem (TIG, MMA etc.);
  • Experiência no uso de ferramentas elétricas ou manuais (serras, esquadros, paquímetros etc.);
  • Capacidade de ler e interpretar documentos e desenhos técnicos;
  • Conhecimento das normas relacionadas com a segurança (NRs);
  • Certificação profissional (por exemplo, um certificado de soldagem AWS) será uma vantagem.

Competências comportamentais esperadas:

  • Comprometimento com prazos e entregas;
  • Responsabilidade e disciplina no dia a dia de trabalho;
  • Proatividade para executar atividades e apoiar a equipe;
  • Organização e cuidado com ferramentas, materiais e local de trabalho;
  • Boa convivência em equipe, especialmente em ambiente de obra e alojamento;
  • Capacidade de seguir orientações e padrões definidos;
  • Atenção à qualidade e aos detalhes na execução dos serviços;
  • Postura voltada à segurança no trabalho;
  • Flexibilidade para lidar com mudanças de rotina e condições de obra.

Horário de trabalho:

Presencialmente de segunda à quinta-feira das 07:30 às 17:30 e de sexta-feira das 07:30 às 16:30.

Local de trabalho:

Residir na região de Salto, Indaiatuba e Itu.

title: Human Resources Generalist
description:
OIA Global provides customers with an unparalleled suite of scalable and flexible supply chain solutions. Supported by 1,300 forward-thinking employees, we specialize in 3PL, 4PL, sustainability, technology, contract logistics, packaging design and optimization, and raw materials management. Since 1988, we have grown into a $1.3 billion company with a presence in 27 countries and industry expertise in fashion and apparel, consumer goods, healthcare, energy, and industrials. OIA Global is privately held by LDI, Ltd.

Summary: Human Resources Generalist

The Human Resources Generalist is responsible for aligning business objectives with employees and management within designated business units. This role builds effective partnerships across the HR function to deliver value-added services that support the overall goals and strategic direction of the organization. The HR Generalist maintains a strong understanding of the business unit’s financial performance, midrange plans, culture, and competitive landscape.

This position supports a wide range of HR functions with a key focus on recruiting, employee relations, HR project support, and the development and maintenance of Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs). The ideal candidate will be a proactive problem-solver with excellent interpersonal skills, strong business acumen, and a passion for delivering high-quality HR support that drives organizational success.

Supervisory Responsibilities:

  • None

Duties and Responsibilities:

General HR Support

  • Assist with compliance reporting, audits, and HR metrics for the Americas, Mexico, and Brazil.
  • Payroll coordination and support, including working with payroll teams to ensure accurate processing of employee changes, new hires, and terminations.
  • Participate in team meetings, HR planning sessions, and company events.
  • Conducts weekly meetings with respective business units/leaders.
  • Consults with managers, providing HR guidance when appropriate.
  • Analyzes trends and metrics in partnership with the HR team to develop solutions, programs, and policies.
  • Conducts effective, thorough, and objective investigations.
  • Maintains in-depth knowledge of legal requirements related to day-to-day management of employees, reducing legal risks, and ensuring regulatory compliance.
  • Provides day-to-day performance management guidance to line management (e.g., coaching, counseling, career development, disciplinary actions).
  • Works closely with management and employees to improve work relationships, build morale, and increase productivity and retention.
  • Provides HR policy guidance and interpretation.
  • Provides guidance and input on business unit restructures, workforce planning, and succession planning.
  • Identifies training needs for business units and individual coaching needs.
  • Participates in the evaluation and monitoring of training programs to ensure success. Follows up to ensure training objectives are met.
  • Assisting with performance management administration, including tracking performance reviews and supporting managers through the process.
  • Coordination of HR compliance postings and documentation, ensuring required labor law notices and internal documentation are maintained.
  • Support for HR reporting and workforce data analysis, including preparing reports on headcount, turnover, and other HR metrics.

Recruitment & Talent Acquisition

  • Support the recruitment administrative efforts for a variety of roles in the Americas region.

title: Senior Business Analyst
description:
Senior Business Analyst
 
Company Overview
Our client is a growing mining company currently transitioning from exploration through project development and into operations, with strong expansion plans beyond this first phase that will position it as a significant gold producer in the Brazilian market. The business is entering a critical phase, combining operational ramp-up with multiple capital projects.
 
 Job Summary
We are seeking a Senior Business / Commercial Analyst to support the organization during its transition into production while enabling future growth through capital expansion projects.
 
This is a highly visible role reporting directly to the VP of Project Development, with cross-functional exposure across operations, finance, projects, and executive leadership, including interaction with senior stakeholders.
 
The successful candidate will play a key role in driving business planning, performance analysis, and financial modeling to support strategic and operational decision-making.
 
Accountabilities
Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
 
  • Manage the business planning process, including coordination, preparation, and continuous improvement
  • Analyze and report on key business performance metrics across operations, projects, and exploration
  • Prepare and deliver monthly management reports, covering operational, construction, and improvement initiatives
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance the project financial model
  • Support capital allocation processes, including preparation of investment proposals (CAPEX requests)
  • Prepare executive presentations and communications for internal stakeholders and senior leadership
  • Act as a business partner across multiple functions, supporting data-driven decision-making
  • Contribute to the development of processes, governance, and performance management frameworks
  • Identify and drive business improvement initiatives to increase the capital efficiency of the assets
  • Management of 1-2 employees reporting directly to the role
 
 
 Requirements
The ideal candidate must have:
  • Technical degree in Business Administration / Economics / Engineering + business/analytics specialization + industry exposure.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in business analysis within the mining industry, can be across different mining commodities (e.g., gold, iron ore, base metals, etc.)
  • Strong background supporting both project development and operational phases
  • Advanced proficiency in financial modeling (Excel) and presentation tools (PowerPoint)
  • Experience working in capital-intensive environments with multiple projects (CAPEX)
  • Ability to operate effectively in a cross-functional and fast-evolving environment
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, with confidence interacting with senior leadership and Board level
  • Advanced or fluent English is mandatory (daily interaction)
 
Profile:
  • Mature, hands-on, and highly analytical professional
  • Strong business acumen with the ability to connect financial insights to operational performance
  • Structured and detail-oriented, with the ability to bring clarity in complex environments
  • Proactive, adaptable, and comfortable working in a dynamic and growing organization
  • Excellent communication and influencing skills
 
Work Model: This position offers a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between on-site and remote work:
 
  • Approximately 50% of the time based on site (operations/projects in Para State)
  • Approximately 50% remote (home office)
 
This structure enables close connection with operations while maintaining flexibility for analytical and strategic work.
 
 Why join
This is a unique opportunity to join a mining company at a pivotal moment, transitioning into operations while scaling its footprint through strategic expansion projects. The role offers high visibility, direct exposure to leadership, and the chance to shape the company’s performance management and decision-making processes.
 
 The Rewards
The position offers a competitive remuneration package including eligibility to participate in the Company’s Employee Share Option Plan.
 
 Contact us
Please apply directly by submitting your resume, preferably as a Microsoft Word document

title: Marketing AI Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our "agentic" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a "Builder" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

• Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

• Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

• Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to "read" prospect behavior and trigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

• Performance & Guardrails: Establish "human-in-the-loop" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

• System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

• Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

• AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.g., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

• Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.g., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.com) or code-based frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, CrewAI).

• Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex "reasoning loops" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

• Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company’s internal knowledge base.

• Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Founder's Associate
description:
**You're here because something else has been letting you down.**

A trainee program that doesn't actually grow you. A BigCo that promises fast growth and takes 5 years. A consulting firm where all you see is PowerPoint. A startup that's really just a BigCo with beer on Fridays.

You want something else. Something you build yourself.

We have that.

---

### Who we are

Sofira is an AI-first legaltech. We create AI agents that automate repetitive corporate legal work.

The legal industry in Brazil is broken. Large enterprises spend millions on legal claims every year.

Our mission is to apply artificial intelligence to solve real pain points, bringing efficiency and scale to complex operations.

---

### The role: Founder's Associate

You will work directly with the CEO to **build and automate processes, define strategy, and stand up new areas of the company from scratch** -- whatever is most important and most urgent in that week.

In practice, this means your week-to-week looks wildly different:

- One week you're 100% focused on fundraising: researching investors, building the deck, sharpening the strategy.

- The next week you're building an automation bot that sources candidates for our next hire.

- The next week you're standing up our commercial machine from zero: ICP, lead lists, cadences, CRM.

- Sometimes you're doing all three in the same week.

The common thread: you figure out what matters most, execute, and ask for help when stuck -- you don't suffer in silence.

---

### Your first 30 days

- **Week 1:** understand everything about Sofira -- product, customers, market, strategy, team. By the end of the week you can explain us in 60 seconds to a stranger.

- **Week 2:** map everything that can be automated. Surface the 5 highest-leverage automations we should build.

- **Week 3:** build the commercial machine from scratch -- ICP, lead sourcing, cadences, CRM, outbound sequences.

- **Week 4:** start generating your own demands. You see what needs to be built next and you propose it.

By month 12, you've touched commercial, recruitment, fundraising, operations, and probably 1-2 things we haven't even planned for yet.

---

### What you get (beyond salary)

**Absurdly fast learning.** You'll learn in 12 months what takes 5 years at a corporate. No exaggeration.

**Proximity to senior founders.** You'll be in every meeting the CEO is. You'll see product decisions happen. You'll see investor pitches happen. You'll see enterprise contracts being negotiated in real time.

**Premium AI tools on us.** ChatGPT Plus, Claude Max, Cursor, Gemini, Perplexity Pro -- whatever helps you move faster, paid by the company.

---

### Where this role can take you

In 18-24 months, depending on how you perform, you'll have 3 open paths:

- **Head of an area you built yourself** (most likely Growth, Operations, or Recruiting) -- you'll have natural seniority because you built the playbook

- **Chief of Staff** -- you already know how every department works

- **Your own company** -- with what you learn here, you'll be ready to start your own thing, if that's your dream.

---

### Who we're looking for

You:

- Are in your **last year of college** or **up to 2 years post-graduation**

- Are in **Engineering (any), Economics, Business Administration, Accounting, Computer Science, or a similar analytical field**

- Come from a **strong university** (Insper, ESPM, FGV, USP, Unicamp, ITA, PUC-RJ/SP, IBMEC, Mackenzie, Federal Universities, or equivalent)

- **Built something real during college** -- inside an empresa junior, entrepreneurship league, AIESEC, a side project, a startup, or a student organization. We care less about the title on your resume and more about the output: something that existed because you made it exist.

And also:

- **You get shit done.** Give you a task with no time, no budget, and no idea how to do it -- you still deliver. You're the person people call when everything's on fire and someone needs to fix it. You squeeze blood from stones.

- **You hate doing by hand what could be automated.** You're allergic to inefficiency. When you catch yourself doing the same task twice, you start plotting how to kill the third time -- with AI, a script, a no-code tool, anything. Manual work that a robot could do makes you twitch.

- **You fall into rabbit holes.** When a topic grabs you, you disappear into it. You've spent an entire weekend learning why airplane windows have a tiny hole, how submarines stay underwater, or something equally random -- just because you couldn't let go. You're self-taught by default. Nobody has to tell you to go learn something.

- **You run multiple things in parallel -- and you like it that way.** Being locked onto one single focus for 6 months would bore you to death. You get energy from context-switching, not tired from it.

- **You want to be great. Yesterday.** Whether that means running your own company one day, being the best at what you do, or leading a team -- you're not willing to wait 5 years to see yourself there. You feel the urgency.

- **You're tech and AI first.** You didn't major in Computer Science, but you speak tech fluently. You prompt well. You read docs. You're comfortable with tools, APIs, and automations even if you don't build them from scratch. If something is possible with code or AI, you know it's possible -- and you'll figure out how.

You've probably already turned down a "stable" and predictable offer because you know it's not for you.

---

### The honest deal

We work a lot. This is not a 9-to-5 job.

We're building something from zero on top of a R$140 billion market that hasn't seen real innovation in 20 years. That takes everything we have.

In return we give:

- **Competitive PJ salary.**

- **Real ownership of what we build.** We dream big, and we want everyone who builds it alongside us to come along for the ride. You'll own a real piece of the company -- yours to earn as you grow with us.

---

### This is NOT for you if

- You need someone to tell you exactly what to do every day

- You prefer stable, predictable environments with well-defined processes

- You want to be a specialist in one thing

- You feel uncomfortable when you don't know something yet

- You want an impressive title more than real impact

- You don't tolerate working on multiple fronts at the same time

- You expect promotions based on tenure

If you read this far and felt uncomfortable with any of these points -- respect the discomfort. Don't apply.

---

### How to apply

Apply and send me (Priscila Holanda) a DM answering this one question:

**"Tell me about the time you most successfully hacked some (non-computer) system to your advantage."**

Be specific. We want the actual story.
